summary: Fixed two P1 findings: (1) Task 2 Step 1 now adds `expect(rawRow!.sourceRequestMeta).toMatchObject({ path: "/pools" })` alongside the HTTP call assertion, ensuring the test validates the updated path metadata that Task 2 Step 3 writes to the implementation. (2) Task 1 signature_changes now includes `AcceptOrcaPoolResponseResult` because the `wrapper` property type changes from `OrcaPoolData` to `OrcaPoolResponse` when the parser switches from object-only to array-validated parsing; this exported symbol was missing from the manifest.
